courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 軌道道碴搗固整正
related.transfer: 可遷移「接頭金屬質量」與「孔隙面積比例」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；軌道道碴搗固整正的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Joint metal mass" and "Void area fraction" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Ballast tamping and track alignment must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦現場接頭熱量收縮形貌與無損檢測；軌道道碴搗固整正則以道碴重排支承恢復與幾何保真為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on field-joint heat shrinkage profile and nondestructive inspection; Ballast tamping and track alignment centres on ballast rearrangement support recovery and geometry fidelity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「接頭金屬質量」與「搗固循環產能」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到軌道道碴搗固整正，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「整正後回沉率」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Joint metal mass” and “Tamping cycle productivity”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Ballast tamping and track alignment, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Post-correction settlement ratio", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「接頭金屬質量」與「道岔分岔角估算」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Joint metal mass” and “Turnout divergence angle”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to High-speed turnout assembly, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fastener clamp-force allocation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鋼軌鋁熱焊接
history.text: 本課把鋼軌鋁熱焊接放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。鋁熱焊課程只分析接頭能量、凝固收縮與焊後驗證；化學配方、點火及現場操作均不由教學模型指定，重點是辨認外觀與內部品質的差異。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Aluminothermic rail welding in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. This aluminothermic-weld course analyses joint energy, solidification shrinkage and post-weld verification; it specifies no chemical recipe, ignition or field procedure, and distinguishes visible profile from internal quality. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「接頭金屬質量」到「檢測掃描間距」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Joint metal mass" through "Inspection scan spacing" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
